luffy.name: Monkey D. Luffy
luffy.description: Captain of the Straw Hat Pirates with a dream to find the One Piece and become the Pirate King.

reveals.true_identity: Sun God Nika (Mythical Zoan Hito Hito)

zoro.name: Roronoa Zoro
zoro.description: Master swordsman of the Three-Sword Style and first mate of the Straw Hat Pirates.

nami.name: Nami
nami.description: Genius navigator and cartographer of the Straw Hat Pirates who dreams of drawing a complete map of the entire world.

usopp.name: Usopp
usopp.description: Master sniper and gadgeteer who dreams of becoming a brave warrior of the sea like the giants of Elbaf.

sanji.name: Vinsmoke Sanji
sanji.description: Cook of the Straw Hat Pirates, prince of Germa 66, master of the Black Leg style and Ifrit Jambe seeking the All Blue.

chopper.name: Tony Tony Chopper
chopper.description: Blue-nosed reindeer doctor who ate the Human-Human Fruit, capable of curing any disease.

robin.name: Nico Robin
robin.description: Sole survivor of Ohara capable of reading the ancient Poneglyphs and deciphering the true history of the Void Century.

shanks.name: Red-Haired Shanks
shanks.description: Chief of the Red Hair Pirates and one of the Four Emperors who inspired Luffy to become a pirate.

whitebeard.name: Edward Newgate
whitebeard.description: Legendary Emperor of the Sea and captain of the Whitebeard Pirates who ushered in the Great Pirate Era.

blackbeard.name: Marshall D. Teach
blackbeard.description: Admiral of the Blackbeard Pirates wielding dual Devil Fruit powers: Dark-Dark and Tremor-Tremor fruits.

kaido.name: Kaido of the Beasts
kaido.description: Emperor of the Sea occupying Wano Country with the Mythical Azure Dragon Devil Fruit.

akainu.name: Sakazuki (Akainu)
akainu.description: Leader of the entire Marine military force, wielding the devastating Mag-Mag Devil Fruit.

dragon.name: Monkey D. Dragon
dragon.description: Leader of the Revolutionary Army and father of Monkey D. Luffy.

roger.name: Gol D. Roger
roger.description: The first person in over 800 years to conquer the entire Grand Line and reach Laugh Tale, leaving behind the One Piece.

tier-rookie.name: East Blue Rookie / Novice
tier-rookie.description: Initial pirate bounties under 30 Million Berries.

tier-supernova.name: Worst Generation / Supernova
tier-supernova.description: Rookies reaching Sabaody Archipelago with bounties exceeding 100 Million Berries.

tier-commander.name: Warlord / Yonko Commander
tier-commander.description: World-class warriors with bounties between 300 Million and 1 Billion Berries.

tier-emperor-admiral.name: Emperor of the Sea / Marine Admiral
tier-emperor-admiral.description: The four Emperors (Yonko) and Fleet Admirals commanding world-destroying armies; bounties 1.5B – 4.5B Berries.

tier-pirate-king.name: Pirate King Legend
tier-pirate-king.description: Conqueror of the Grand Line possessing the ultimate bounty (5B+ Berries).

plane-four-blues.name: The Four Blues & Grand Line (Paradise)
plane-four-blues.description: The outer seas (East, West, North, South Blue) and the first half of the Grand Line navigated sequentially via Log Pose.

plane-sky-ocean.name: Sky Islands & Ocean Depths
plane-sky-ocean.description: Hidden vertical realms: Skypiea 10,000 meters in the cloud sea and Fish-Man Island 10,000 meters under the ocean floor.

plane-new-world.name: The New World (Shinsekai)
plane-new-world.description: The treacherous final half of the Grand Line ruled by the Four Emperors, terminating at Laugh Tale.

loc-foosha-village.name: Foosha Village & Dawn Island
loc-foosha-village.description: Luffy's peaceful hometown in the Goa Kingdom where Red-Haired Shanks sacrificed his arm to save young Luffy and entrusted him with the Straw Hat.

loc-shells-town.name: Shells Town (Marine 153rd Branch)
loc-shells-town.description: Marine base town governed by tyrannical 'Axe-Hand' Morgan, where Luffy freed Roronoa Zoro from execution and made him his first mate.

loc-orange-town.name: Orange Town
loc-orange-town.description: Town evacuated due to Buggy the Clown's pirate rampages; where Luffy, Zoro, and Nami first teamed up and saved Mayor Boodle and dog Chouchou.

loc-syrup-village.name: Syrup Village (Gecko Islands)
loc-syrup-village.description: Usopp's hillside village where the Straw Hats defeated Captain Kuro and the Black Cat Pirates, acquiring the caravel Going Merry.

loc-baratie.name: Baratie Ocean Restaurant
loc-baratie.description: Floating fish-shaped ocean restaurant founded by Chef Zeff; site of Don Krieg's armada attack, Mihawk's duel with Zoro, and Sanji's recruitment.

loc-arlong-park.name: Arlong Park (Conomi Islands)
loc-arlong-park.description: Towering headquarters of the fishman tyrant Arlong; demolished to rubble by Luffy to liberate Nami and Cocoyasi Village from eight years of slavery.

loc-loguetown.name: Loguetown (The Beginning & The End)
loc-loguetown.description: Legendary city where Pirate King Gol D. Roger was born and executed; final port in the East Blue where Monkey D. Dragon saved Luffy from Smoker.
aliases: Town of the Beginning and the End

loc-reverse-mountain.name: Reverse Mountain & Twin Cape
loc-reverse-mountain.description: Ascending ocean currents where all four blues converge to enter the Grand Line; home to the lighthouse keeper Crocus and the island whale Laboon.

loc-whiskey-peak.name: Whiskey Peak (Cactus Island)
loc-whiskey-peak.description: Town that welcomes pirates with wine and celebration only to slaughter them; where Zoro defeated 100 Baroque Works bounty hunters in the moonlight.

loc-little-garden.name: Little Garden
loc-little-garden.description: Prehistoric jungle island populated by dinosaurs and giant warriors Dorry and Brogy, who have fought a sacred duel of honor for over a century.

loc-drum-island.name: Drum Island (Sakura Kingdom)
loc-drum-island.description: Permanent winter country ruled by the drum rockies; where Dr. Hiriluk's cherry blossom powder bloomed and Tony Tony Chopper joined the crew.

loc-alabasta.name: Kingdom of Alabasta
loc-alabasta.description: Vast desert realm beset by drought and civil war plotted by Baroque Works; saved when Luffy defeated Warlord Sir Crocodile in the royal tombs.

loc-jaya.name: Jaya & Mock Town
loc-jaya.description: Lawless pirate haven where Bellamy mocked dreams, Marshall D. Teach declared 'A man's dream will never die!', and the Knock Up Stream was located.

loc-water-7.name: Water 7 (Metropolis of Water)
loc-water-7.description: Stunning canal metropolis of world-renowned shipwrights (Galley-La Company), sea train Puffing Tom, and birthplace of the Thousand Sunny.

loc-enies-lobby.name: Enies Lobby (Judicial Island)
loc-enies-lobby.description: Everday judicial stronghold of the World Government; where the Straw Hats burned the World Government flag to rescue Nico Robin from CP9.

loc-thriller-bark.name: Thriller Bark (Ghost Island Ship)
loc-thriller-bark.description: World's largest pirate ship masked as a haunted island within the Florian Triangle; where Warlord Gecko Moria stole shadows and Zoro absorbed Luffy's pain.

loc-sabaody.name: Sabaody Archipelago
loc-sabaody.description: Giant mangrove archipelago at the base of the Red Line; notorious for Celestial Dragon slave auctions, the Eleven Supernovas, and Kuma's crew dispersion.

loc-marineford.name: Marineford Naval Headquarters
loc-marineford.description: Fortress of absolute justice where the Summit War shook the foundation of the world, concluding with the deaths of Portgas D. Ace and Edward Newgate.

loc-skypiea.name: Skypiea & Upper Yard
loc-skypiea.description: Heavenly realm floating 10,000 meters high upon the White-White Sea, holding the ancient golden city of Shandora and ruled by 'God' Enel.

loc-weatheria.name: Weatheria (Sky Weather Island)
loc-weatheria.description: Artificial meteorological cloud island drifting freely across the sky, where Nami mastered New World weather science during the two-year timeskip.

loc-impel-down.name: Impel Down (Great Underwater Prison)
loc-impel-down.description: Heavily fortified subterranean ocean prison submerged in the Calm Belt with six levels of brutal torment; breached by Luffy in a desperate rescue bid.

loc-fishman-island.name: Fish-Man Island (Ryugu Kingdom)
loc-fishman-island.description: Bioluminescent kingdom encased in a giant dual-membrane bubble 10,000 meters beneath the Red Line; home of Princess Shirahoshi (Ancient Weapon Poseidon).

loc-punk-hazard.name: Punk Hazard (PH-006)
loc-punk-hazard.description: Ruined laboratory island permanently split between blazing magma and freezing blizzards by Admirals Akainu and Aokiji; where Luffy and Law forged their alliance.

loc-dressrosa.name: Kingdom of Dressrosa
loc-dressrosa.description: Island of passion, flamenco, and living toys ruled by Warlord Donquixote Doflamingo; site of Corrida Colosseum and formation of the 5,600-strong Straw Hat Grand Fleet.

loc-zou.name: Zou (Mokomo Dukedom)
loc-zou.description: Phantom nation carried on the massive back of the ancient elephant Zunesha for 1,000 years; sanctuary of the warrior Mink Tribe and guardian of a red Road Poneglyph.

loc-whole-cake.name: Whole Cake Island (Totto Land)
loc-whole-cake.description: Capital island of Emperor Big Mom's sweet confectionery archipelago; site of the tea party infiltration, Sanji's rescue, and Luffy's awakening against Charlotte Katakuri.

loc-wano.name: Wano Country & Onigashima
loc-wano.description: Isolated mountainous realm of samurai where the fire festival raid culminated in Luffy awakening the Drums of Liberation (Sun God Nika) and toppling Kaido.

loc-hachinosu.name: Pirate Island Hachinosu (Beehive)
loc-hachinosu.description: Birthplace of the legendary Rocks Pirates and modern fortress of Emperor Blackbeard Marshall D. Teach; where Monkey D. Garp unleashed Galaxy Impact.

loc-egghead.name: Egghead Future Island
loc-egghead.description: 500-years-in-the-future laboratory island of Dr. Vegapunk, holding Punk Records, Iron Giant Emet, and the scene of the Five Elders' cataclysmic Buster Call.

loc-elbaf.name: Elbaf (Warland of Giants)
loc-elbaf.description: Sacred land of the mighty giant warriors beneath the colossal cosmic tree Yggdrasil; homeland of Dorry, Brogy, and Prince Loki.

loc-laugh-tale.name: Laugh Tale (The Final Island)
loc-laugh-tale.description: The elusive final island of the Grand Line reached only by triangulating the four Road Poneglyphs, where Joy Boy left his world-shaking treasure.

arc-east-blue.name: East Blue Saga
arc-east-blue.description: Luffy sets to sea, recruits Zoro, Nami, Usopp, and Sanji, and earns his first 30M Bounty.

arc-alabasta.name: Alabasta Saga
arc-alabasta.description: Entering the Grand Line, sailing with Princess Vivi, and defeating Warlord Crocodile (Bounty: 100M).

arc-skypiea.name: Skypiea Sky Island Saga
arc-skypiea.description: Riding the Knock Up Stream into the White-White Sea to defeat God Enel and ring the Golden Bell of Shandora.

arc-water7.name: Water 7 & Enies Lobby Saga
arc-water7.description: Declaring war on the World Government to rescue Robin, unveiling Gear 2 and Gear 3 (Bounty: 300M).

arc-summit-war.name: Summit War of Marineford Saga
arc-summit-war.description: Thriller Bark, Sabaody, infiltrating Impel Down, the cataclysmic battle at Marineford, and the 2-year timeskip (Bounty: 400M).

arc-dressrosa.name: Fishman Island & Dressrosa Saga
arc-dressrosa.description: Reunion after 2 years, descending to Fishman Island, teaming with Law on Punk Hazard, and smashing Doflamingo with Gear 4 (Bounty: 500M).

arc-wano.name: Four Emperors & Wano Country Saga
arc-wano.description: Zou Road Poneglyph, Whole Cake Island tea party raid, samurai alliance war, awakening Gear 5 / Sun God Nika, crowned Emperor (Bounty: 3B).

arc-egghead.name: Egghead Future Island Saga
arc-egghead.description: Confronting the Five Elders and Admiral Kizaru, unveiling the Ancient Kingdom and the World Sinking truth, setting sail for Elbaf.

event-strawhat-promise.name: The Straw Hat Oath
event-strawhat-promise.description: Shanks sacrifices his left arm to save young Luffy from the Lord of the Coast and gives him his Straw Hat, sealing their legendary promise.

event-baratie-duel.name: Mihawk vs Zoro Duel at Baratie
event-baratie-duel.description: Dracule Mihawk cuts Don Krieg's galleon in half and easily deflects Zoro's swords with a tiny knife; Zoro swears through tears never to lose again.

event-arlong-park-destroyed.name: Fall of Arlong Park & Nami Freed
event-arlong-park-destroyed.description: Luffy destroys the chart room of Nami's captivity with Gomu Gomu no Battle Axe, completely leveling Arlong Park into the ground.

event-loguetown-escape.name: Scaffold Lightning Miracle & Smoker Clash
event-loguetown-escape.description: A miraculous lightning strike saves Luffy from Buggy on Roger's execution platform, and Monkey D. Dragon steps in to shield Luffy from Smoker.

event-reverse-mountain-entry.name: Reverse Mountain & Laboon Reunion Pact
event-reverse-mountain-entry.description: The Going Merry shoots down the Reverse Mountain canal into the Grand Line; Luffy paints his pirate mark on Laboon and promises to return.

event-drum-island-cherry-blossom.name: Miracle Cherry Blossoms of Drum Island
event-drum-island-cherry-blossom.description: Dr. Kureha fires Dr. Hiriluk's pink chemical powder into the snowy sky, transforming the snow peaks into giant blooming cherry blossoms.

event-alabasta-defeat-crocodile.name: Defeat of Warlord Crocodile in Alabasta
event-alabasta-defeat-crocodile.description: Blood-soaked Luffy launches Crocodile through the bedrock ceiling with Gomu Gomu no Storm, bringing rain back to the Kingdom of Alabasta.

event-skypiea-golden-bell.name: Ringing the Golden Bell of Shandora
event-skypiea-golden-bell.description: Luffy smashes Enel into the Golden Bell using a giant golden rifle sphere, ringing the bell across the sky to prove the City of Gold was in heaven.

event-gear-second.name: Gear Second & Third Breakthrough
event-gear-second.description: Luffy pumps his blood at superhuman speeds, unveiling Gear 2 and Gear 3 against CP9 Blueno and Rob Lucci.

event-enies-lobby-flag.name: Straw Hats Declare War on World Government
event-enies-lobby-flag.description: Sogeking shoots through the World Government flag at Luffy's command, answering Robin's tearful plea: 'I want to live!'

event-thriller-bark-sacrifice.name: Zoro's Ultimate Sacrifice: 'Nothing Happened'
event-thriller-bark-sacrifice.description: Zoro offers his life to Bartholomew Kuma in exchange for Luffy's, taking in all of Luffy's agony and standing bloodied: 'Nothing at all happened.'

event-sabaody-celestial-punch.name: Punching the Celestial Dragon at Sabaody
event-sabaody-celestial-punch.description: Luffy punches World Noble Saint Charlos so hard the comic returns to black and white sketches, triggering an Admiral summons.

event-impel-down-breakout.name: Historic Great Breakout from Impel Down
event-impel-down-breakout.description: Luffy, Jinbe, Crocodile, Ivankov, and Buggy lead 241 prisoners to escape the impregnable submarine fortress, commandeering a Marine battleship.

event-marineford-war.name: The Paramount War of Marineford
event-marineford-war.description: The clash of titans at Marineford; Ace dies protecting Luffy, and Whitebeard roars 'The One Piece does exist!' before dying on his feet.

event-fishman-island-pledge.name: Liberation of Fish-Man Island & Big Mom Challenge
event-fishman-island-pledge.description: Luffy crushes Hody Jones, rejects payment, speaks directly to Big Mom via Den Den Mushi, and claims Fishman Island under Straw Hat protection.

event-dressrosa-gear-fourth.name: Gear Fourth Boundman Smashes Doflamingo
event-dressrosa-gear-fourth.description: Luffy inflates his muscle structure and unleashes Gear Fourth: Boundman, smashing Doflamingo into the underground city with King Kong Gun.

event-gear-fifth.name: Awakening of Sun God Nika (Gear 5)
event-gear-fifth.description: Luffy's heartbeat plays the Drums of Liberation; awakening the true Mythical Zoan God Nika fruit to toss Kaido across Onigashima.

event-egghead-broadcast.name: Vegapunk Worldwide Void Century Broadcast
event-egghead-broadcast.description: Dr. Vegapunk's death activates an unblockable transponder broadcast to the entire planet: 'The world is doomed to sink beneath the ocean!'

rel-blackbeard-luffy.label: Clashing Wills of D. & Pirate Throne
